title: Moonlit Tableau
timingBasis: Subagent UTC clock from reading the game brief through completion of game checks

revisions.timingBasis: Wall clock from Luna's first revision start through its final fix check
changes: Aligned the stock, waste, and four foundation slots with the tableau and removed extra top-row slots.
Added double-click to send eligible exposed tableau and waste cards to their foundations.
Fixed a first-draw exception before the opening deal.

validation.layout: Six nonoverlapping top-row slots at 600, 823, and 1280 CSS pixels in an instrumented Canvas draw test
validation.interaction: Simulated startup, legal and illegal double-clicks, card reveal, move counts, manual drag, and win detection

mobileSupportNotes: The fixed minimum card width clips the tableau in phone viewports narrower than 430 CSS pixels. Restart during a hand requires R.
